tools.name: sky_seeing
tools.description: Is tonight actually usable for stargazing or astrophotography? Combines real dark hours and true moon illumination (computed from first principles) with live hourly cloud cover, weighting low cloud above high cloud. Returns a 0-100 usability score per night hour, the best consecutive usable run, and

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Stateful quake subscriptions. Unlike a local tool, the filter and its cursor are stored on the server, so poll returns ONLY events newer than your last poll - no re-scanning, no client-side dedupe. Actions: create (min_magnitude, place), poll (id), list, delete (id).

tools.name: earthquakes
tools.description: Recent earthquakes from USGS. Filter by window (hour/day/week/month), minimum magnitude, and place text. Returns magnitude, place, depth, time.

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current weather and the next 12 hours for a latitude/longitude, from Open-Meteo. No API key required.

tools.name: iss_position
tools.description: Current latitude/longitude of the International Space Station.

tools.name: earth_now
tools.description: One-shot summary of what is happening on Earth right now: 24h earthquake totals plus current ISS position.

tools.name: sky_tonight
tools.description: Real sky for a place and night: sunrise/sunset, moonrise/moonset, true moon phase and illumination, and the best dark window for stargazing. Computed from first principles (no key, no ephemeris file).

tools.name: moon_phase
tools.description: Current (or given date's) moon phase and illumination for a location.

tools.name: sky_at
tools.description: The real sky for a place and an instant: sunrise/sunset, moonrise/moonset, true moon phase and illumination, and the best dark window for stargazing. Pure astronomy, no API key.
